web-guide-idea-54.audience: Learners, actors or hosts practising a particular language.
web-guide-idea-54.offer: Help someone hear and reproduce sounds in a defined variety of speech. Keep the goal intelligibility or performance needs, not erasing identity.
web-guide-idea-54.steps.0: Ask for a short passage and the desired context.
web-guide-idea-54.steps.1: Model difficult sounds and compare them slowly.
web-guide-idea-54.steps.2: Practise the passage naturally and recap a few cues.
web-guide-idea-54.equipment: A phone, earphones and the passage to practise. Recording practice is optional and requires agreement.
web-guide-idea-54.returnReason: Build a sequence around new sounds or longer dialogue after the learner practises.
web-guide-idea-54.promotion: Record a sample line and explain the language variety you know.
